generation.scope: At all four exceptional slopes the discriminant is a double smooth quadric. On its invertible chart standard Koszul left/right AS regularity holds exactly when both determinant quadratics are genuine. This includes the two-conic and four-line degenerations, using ruling obstructions and balanced polygon pencils.

mathematical_computation.scope: Verified double quadrics, eight divisibilities, opposite pencil minors, opposite determinant signs for the evaluation blocks, and a 256-entry gauge transformation. Rechecked the polygon degree enumeration.
